settings.heading: UK bed sizes
settings.text: Standard UK mattress sizes. Bed frames are larger than the mattress, so allow extra room for the headboard and frame. Ask us for the exact external size of any bed.
settings.note: Need something in between? We can make beds to custom sizes. Request a bespoke quote.

settings.heading: Not sure what to choose?
settings.text: Talk to the people who make the beds. We'll help with sizes, fabrics, storage and access, with no pressure.
